paragraphs: This is how it is cited in Otzar Yisrael; it should instead be under the entry R' Yissa bar Acha.[^1]

notes.text: The target title is abbreviated and retained as R', restoring the historical neutral title. Issi and Yissa remain distinct source forms. Should instead be under is Hyman’s corrective entry instruction, not a verified encyclopedia correction or identity binding. Otzar Yisrael is left at the source’s level of specificity and independently unverified.
